*Note on initial search:* Google Search immediately served an automated query reCAPTCHA block on this network IP, so pricing and financing calculations were retrieved directly from the live Tesla Model 3 Design Studio with Los Angeles delivery selected.

* **Model:** Tesla Model 3 Rear-Wheel Drive (Standard Stealth Grey, 18'' Prismata wheels)
* **Lease Term:** 36 months / 10,000 miles per year
* **Headline / Advertised Figures (Excludes Taxes & Non-Tesla Fees):**
  * Monthly Payment: $419 / month
  * Due at Delivery: $4,114 (includes $3,000 down payment, $419 first month's payment, $695 acquisition fee)
* **Realistic Baseline (Includes Estimated Los Angeles Taxes & Government Fees):**

* **Credits, Rebates & Incentives:**

  * **End of Lease Terms:** $395 disposition fee; buyout option at $23,796 plus fees. Excess mileage fee: $0.25/mile.

  * **Type:** Private room in a newer multi-unit home / apartment (1,000 sq ft shared living area).
  * **Inclusions:** **All utilities included in the rent** (water, power, trash).
  * **Terms:** Month-to-month flexibility (1-year maximum listed), no credit check or security deposit required, free application.
  * **Amenities:** In-unit washer and dryer, secure gated entrance, on-site fitness center, and recording studio.
